rooms.name: Floor Lobby / Lift Landing
rooms.notes: Central core lobby serving 2 lifts and 1 stair on this floor. Circular floor plate; lobby wraps core.

rooms.name: Main Circulation Corridor
rooms.notes: Annular corridor around central core — characteristic of 30m circular floor plate. Provides access to all perimeter offices.

rooms.name: Office Reception
rooms.notes: Welcoming reception point for office tenants on this floor; glass curtain-wall facade provides natural light.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office A
rooms.notes: Large open-plan workspace occupying north-east arc of circular floor plate; full-height glass curtain wall.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office B
rooms.notes: Second open-plan workspace on south-west arc; accommodates second tenant or department.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 1
rooms.notes: 8-person meeting room with glazed partition; perimeter location for natural light.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 2
rooms.notes: 6-person meeting room; smaller pod suited to informal huddles.

rooms.name: Pantry / Tea Point
rooms.notes: Shared pantry for both office zones; CPWD DSR provision per floor. MEP wet riser coordinated with structural core.

rooms.name: Toilet Block (Common)
rooms.notes: Unisex toilet block with separate male/female/accessible compartments; NBC Part 9 plumbing fixtures per occupant load.

rooms.name: Service / Store Room
rooms.notes: Housekeeping store, electrical DB, and janitor cupboard consolidated per NBC Part 8 MEP requirements.

rooms.name: External Terrace / Balcony Strip
rooms.notes: Curved external balcony following circular facade on north arc; supports passive cooling, Bangalore climate. Rainwater harvesting channel integrated along parapet.

response.floor_summary: Floor 2 is a shared office workspace floor accommodating two open-plan tenant zones with dedicated meeting rooms, a central reception, pantry, common toilets, and a curved external balcony — all organised around the annular circulation corridor of the 30 m circular tower plate.
